description: This file defines the RedisGrainStorageProviderBuilder class which implements the IProviderBuilder interface for configuring Redis-based grain storage in an Orleans silo. It registers two provider attributes and contains logic to configure Redis storage options based on configuration sections, including handling connection multiplexer creation and serializer setup.

classes.name: RedisGrainStorageProviderBuilder
classes.description: Internal sealed class implementing IProviderBuilder for configuring Redis grain storage in Orleans.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures Redis grain storage options for the ISiloBuilder based on provided configuration section.
